name: Akebia Therapeutics
summary:
Akebia Therapeutics (AKBA) reported a loss of $0.03 per share on revenue of $53.54 million for the first quarter ended March 2026. The consensus estimate was a loss of $0.01 per share on revenue of $56.48 million. The company missed consensus estimates by 200.00% while revenue fell 6.61% compared to the same quarter a year ago.

Akebia Therapeutics Inc is a biopharmaceutical company. It is engaged in the development of proprietary therapeutics based on hypoxia inducible factor, or HIF, biology and the commercialization of these products for patients with kidney disease.
subject: Akebia Therapeutics Missed Consensus Estimates
